programmes.programName: Dottorato di Ricerca in Ingegneria Industriale
programmes.evidence: Current official DII page explicitly titles a PhD in Industrial Engineering, hosted by the exact Industrial Engineering Department, and divides the same doctorate into Aerospace/Naval, Energy/Mechanical, and Engineering Management/Quality/Data Science curricula. Count one award, not three curricula.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: The official Industrial Engineering department FAQ calls the programme a three-year PhD, states 115–150 ECTS of independent research culminating in a thesis, and describes doctoral admission.

limitations: Exact Italian award label retained; English department page calls it PhD. Three internal curricula do not create three distinct programmes.
The separately mentioned Technology, Innovation and Management doctorate is administered by University of Bergamo, so it is not duplicated as a Federico II award.

branches.conclusion: Business-school doctorate named-field inventory not yet checked. The DII page separately mentions a Technology, Innovation and Management doctorate administered by University of Bergamo, not a Federico II degree.

Official DII programme and research-office unit pages establish current Industrial Engineering research doctorate, one degree with three curricula; unrelated aerospace/naval/mechanical curricula are not counted separately.
